doc.title: Loren Schoenberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019

title: Praise for the Fillius archive and an offer to swap interviews
summary: Schoenberg praises Rowe's archive and proposes interviewing Rowe in return.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: So I’m going to make a proposal that when I do Part Two with you I’ll come down and we’ll do it there in the aura would be there and I’ll get to see your things.
Yeah. Well only on one condition.
If I can interview you for our archives. MR. Okay.

Because your archive is unique, and as I told you before, we filmed and I think it’s the second time I’m using the word unctuous, but I’m not trying to be unctuous but you know what you’ve done consistently for a quarter of a century is invaluable and unique. Yes there are other archives or other interviews and we all know them. But you have create a finite thing based on what seems to be your personal thing with the people that you interview somehow, and some of them I can tell you are friends with and some maybe you never met before, but they’re informal and like I told you recently I mean Buddy DeFranco, I went back and just started checking out some of your — and as soon as I started checking out your Buddy DeFranco interview it sent me to 15 records of his and other things, and then he talked about this and then so and so. And you know he said it’s funny when we had whoever here, he mentioned something about something and I’d go and watch that one. And I’m looking forward to your interviews being placed at someplace where they’ll be accessible — well they are accessible.
Absolutely. But even beyond YouTube. Because it’s a unique thing and it was an inspiration to part of what we did with our project.
